caption: swipe for the week the sky had: a new moon and three planets changing direction. dec 7 – 13, 2026.

slides.headline: three planets changed direction this week. *catch up*
a new moon in *sagittarius* reset the honesty meter
slides.body: if you set one intention, check it is still the one.

slides.headline: *venus* squared pluto and the jealousy came out
slides.body: if someone played games, you learned something useful.

slides.headline: *saturn* went direct, then mercury trined it
slides.body: plans got traction. a good week for a serious talk that went fine.

slides.headline: *venus* and mars played nice saturday morning
slides.body: if you asked someone out, that was good timing.

slides.headline: *jupiter* turned retrograde in leo, neptune turned direct
slides.body: big plans slow down to be checked. the fog thins.

slides.headline: the one to watch: *sun trine jupiter* on friday
slides.body: the friendliest aspect of the month. save the big ask for it.
